## Description

Blocked on people: the licence (License.txt) must be read and recorded in an ADR that supersedes ADR-015 section 4 before anything is imported. Then the console uploads a release of the NRCeS Common Drug Codes for India (tab-separated flat files), shows a dry-run diff (added, changed, retired) and applies it into the Medvya-wide list built in MDV-P5-064: source Register, the register code and release on each row, class Not verified (CDCI has no Schedule H, H1 or X).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the licence terms are recorded in an ADR, when the owner uploads a release, then the console shows the rows it would add, change and retire before anything is written.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a release is applied twice, when the second run ends, then nothing changed (idempotent per code and release).
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a code missing from a newer release, when it is applied, then that medicine becomes inactive and is never deleted.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given an imported row, when it is saved, then its class is Not verified, never None.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given about 100,000 rows in the list, when a doctor searches, then the search uses an index under row-level security (a word table searched with the leakproof prefix operator, or another reviewed design) and answers within the clinic search budget.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
